record.name: GRACE ACS Risk Score
record.disabled_reason: GRACE uses a validated nomogram with continuous, non-linear point contributions per variable (age, heart rate, systolic BP, creatinine) rather than simple fixed-point criteria. A live calculator needs the official nomogram/coefficient table, which is not yet available in this app - use the published MDCalc or original GRACE nomogram directly. Listed here for reference so it isn't missing from this section.
record.review_note: Factors considered: age, heart rate, systolic blood pressure, serum creatinine, Killip class, cardiac arrest at admission, ST-segment deviation on ECG, and elevated cardiac enzymes. Calculates in-hospital and 6-month mortality/infarction risk for ACS.
